steps.title: Make paper
steps.say: Craft 3 [sugar cane](item:sugar_cane) in a row to get 3 [paper](item:paper).

steps.title: Craft a map
steps.say: Fill the whole crafting grid with 9 [paper](item:paper) to make an empty map.

steps.title: Add a compass
steps.say: For a map that shows where you are, put a [compass](item:compass) in the middle with 8 [paper](item:paper) around it.

steps.title: Fill it in
steps.say: Hold the map and use it. It draws the land around you, and more appears as you walk.

steps.title: Zoom out
steps.say: At a [cartography table](item:cartography_table), add [paper](item:paper) to your map to show more land. You can do it 4 times.

steps.title: Make a copy
steps.say: At a [cartography table](item:cartography_table), add an empty map to copy yours, so a friend can have one.

steps.title: Hang them up
steps.say: Put maps in [item frames](item:item_frame) on a wall, side by side, to make one big map.
